changelog:
* **fix: draw app bars behind status bar** (953d009)
  - Stop the outer nav scaffold padding the host below the status bar.
  - Apply edge-to-edge once in onCreate before setContent.
  - App bar surfaces now extend behind the status bar on every screen.
* **docs: shorten play protect notice in about** (9488ce9)
  - Trim the Play Protect warning so it fits in three lines.
  - Keep the same meaning in a natural voice.
* **fix: drop custom chip ripple for good** (7a58496)
  - Replace the custom chip clickable with plain tap detection so no
    ripple indication node exists at all.
  - Keep button semantics for TalkBack on the custom chip.
  - Preset chips keep their normal ripple.
* **fix: hide clear all when calculator is empty** (c56c767)
  - Hide Clear All icon on total card when there is nothing to clear.
  - Remove unused idle check and dead nothing-to-clear toast branch.
